name: easyeda-pro-control
description: Safety-gated EasyEDA API coverage, fixed typed SDK reads, design operations and seven engineering skills.

interface.longDescription: Seven skills cover control, schematics, PCB layout, libraries, manufacturing, design review and extensions. The API inventory distinguishes public subsets, native equivalents, blocked implementations and omissions. The current reviewed tuple provides calculations, environment/unit and editor metadata, PCB layer/identity/geometry reads, Component metadata, Pad parameters and component child-pad lists. Polygon paths, complete stacks, resolved rules, reverse ownership and schematic pin mapping remain unverified. A project-local symbol metadata reader observes exact name, description, tags, template reference, version and ticket without geometry loading or cloud-library fallback. It proves neither hidden-editor absence nor a safe rename baseline. Ordinary existing-profile launch, retained-owner window observation and one-shot normal closure support disposable project/PCB opening. Closure never chooses Save/Discard or forces exit; acknowledgment and retained termination are separate. Opening can migrate storage and automatically Save. Lost handles, ambiguous launch and quarantine retain their restrictions; inspection never replays operations. Historical abandonment qualifies only specific evidence. The older tuple retains separately guarded readers, footprint typed API operations, native controls, checkpoints and recovery. Current schematic-page, symbol and PCB transactions plus eight metadata writers remain blocked pending current lifecycle adaptation, native structure-job completion and complete SQL-effect proof. Compiled topology and affected exports refuse hidden annotation or Save All. Connected validation is operation- and generation-specific. Arbitrary JavaScript, blind retries and unrestricted Save remain refused. The legacy writer is runtime-disabled. Missing installation files select offline-only startup. The historical reviewed tuple is connected-read-admitted; future mismatches fail closed within each capability profile.
defaultPrompt: Validate the EasyEDA bridge without bypassing compatibility gates.
Inspect the admitted EasyEDA project with exact readers and managed evidence.
Apply the requested typed design change and verify it after saving and reopening.
